scope: Two source-scoped 60-wall-second marker/IMU+marker actual seven-channel runs with execution-only log-K damping. method.central_fusion: ascending-ID image-only ADF with known attachments; broad intermediate projection deferred with every full-covariance branch retained; broad final mixture retained
method.selection: Every reaching cycle evaluates the complete Gaussian/Bingham-mixture J and one complete gradient; visual centering is only an initial-point proposal. Accepted candidates are checked against the recorded position-error expectation constraint.

board_image_only_fusion.sensitive_density_check: Independent chart/full covariance check at fixed tolerances, then recompute products/evidence from exactly disclosed Gaussian operands to avoid condition-amplified last-bit differences; no tolerance widening.

absolute_pose_accuracy.covariance_width_definition: 3*sqrt(trace(P)), a diagnostic Euclidean width; anisotropic Gaussian proxy coverage uses support-aware Mahalanobis chi-square95

K_action_physical_diagnostic.source_scope: historical 0f7 and preceding ccb633, not the new representative-following run
K_action_physical_diagnostic.interpretation: Recorded auxiliary equilibrium delta equals same-K recomputation; selected diagnostic displacement directions mostly agree with true-K physical FK. This is not a proof of globally correct K estimation or successful reaching.

limitations: Physical success is evaluated only by the unchanged 6mm simulator reach condition and absence of forbidden collision across the recorded trajectory. Passing numerical identity/full-J constraints or representative-density follow-through does not establish physical success, calibrated uncertainty, or true K accuracy.
The one-step horizon s constraint is distinct from a guarantee on each 20Hz interpolated physical interval; actual reaching-interval increases are independently counted for each case.

Observation updates can change the relative target error at fixed command. The prior 0f7-source combined 11.72s jump is diagnosed separately in a saved direct-camera artifact and is not automatically attributed to this new run.
The board assumes conditional independence of tag corner likelihoods; shared image errors and ordered ADF approximation are explicit. Final broad mixtures remain; no native mode is dropped.
The existing Bingham-derived core forward moments and single-root-pose approximation need not close exactly under an inverse query; measured residuals are disclosed without cosmetic recentering.
Only selected latest captures are fused; every acquired capture and skipped index is archived. IMU is attached to link_3 in these runs.
Raw detector visibility is image evidence. Physical corner/FK/true-K evaluations are validation only and were not inference/control inputs.
Absolute body accuracy and covariance coverage are measured separately; coverage counts are descriptive, not a calibration guarantee.

representative_refinement_correction.changed_density: Always attempt the already configured bounded score/Armijo refinement, including when the previous representative remains the best fixed start.
representative_refinement_correction.unchanged_density: Exact representative reuse remains permitted when the density ID is unchanged.

historical_visibility_failure.scope: Historical pre-correction diagnosis: the 2372 source could waste time searching despite raw visibility. The new-source strict policy proof is reported separately.

visibility_correction.raw_image_visibility: Fresh real-pixel 15fps detection is kept separate from the slower fused pose-law result.
visibility_correction.raw_visible_hold: During an existing loss-recovery episode, raw image reacquisition brakes and holds; no sweep starts or continues merely because a fresh fused result has not arrived yet. Normal reaching is not held solely because a marker is visible.
visibility_correction.resume: Use a post-stopping valid marker result committed into the active same-K IK plan, preserving every native/goal component.

execution_stiffness_definition.tick: coordinator motion tick, including while inference/IK workers are busy
execution_stiffness_definition.sample: One coordinator filter sample is captured in the IK request and frozen for that complete gradient/selection; the selected plan and that packet are adopted atomically.
execution_stiffness_definition.raw_and_execution_proposal_fields: command_proposal remains raw; execution_command_proposal and execution_stiffness are separate
execution_stiffness_definition.prior_transport: Each actually executed interval records its adopted execution K; exact same-K equilibrium action carries the retained body to the next prior.
execution_stiffness_definition.estimate_changes_between_runs: Changing execution naturally changes commands, observations and subsequent estimated posteriors; raw-record preservation is within a run, not numerical equality to the predecessor experiment.
execution_stiffness_definition.jump_causality_limit: Measured jump differences across asynchronous trajectories do not establish that K alone caused every pose or target jump.

independent_chart_numerics.scope: One original audit-only common-chart comparison had cancellation in the independent 1-cos small-angle coefficient. Runtime analytic inverse and an 80-digit oracle agree within 1.11e-16; stable independent series changes neither the formula nor fixed tolerances, modes, covariance or production source.

measured_execution_comparison.scope: Descriptive comparison to source7403, with asynchronous command/observation trajectories allowed to differ; no K-only causal attribution.

limitations: Different closed-loop observations, body posteriors, goals and plan timing prevent attributing speed differences solely to the filter.
The 0.05 log cap applies to every physical filter tick; frozen IK plans can adopt samples several ticks apart and their K step can exceed this cap.
K filtering reduces the measured maximum adopted-K ratio, while maximum actual tip velocity change at K adoption is not reduced in these trials.
Desired joint velocity can still reverse between -0.048 and +0.048 rad/s; actual sent motion remains acceleration-limited.

initial_test_fixture_failure.scope: The old direct control-worker test request omitted the newly required execution_sample. Test-only request and raw/execution assertions were updated; actual coordinator requests and runtime source were unchanged. The separate clean full-suite result is authoritative.

known_followup_execution_defect.source_scope: 3dae K-damping experiment only; historical evidence before the short-target execution correction
known_followup_execution_defect.finding: At unchanged K the asynchronous velocity executor can move beyond the selected bounded short-horizon command target. Execution beyond that target is not justified by the one-step IK criterion.
known_followup_execution_defect.followup: A separate source/run corrects bounded-target execution and plan expiry; no evidence from that later source is claimed here.

execution_K_figure.time_convention: Raw target changes are drawn at first coordinator availability, not the older image/capture stamp. Filter curves use coordinator ticks during physical motion, and IK points use the frozen filter sample stamp; post-motion estimator-drain events at the clipped terminal timestamp are excluded from the figure. All are physical elapsed time in [0,60] seconds.

marker_after_reach_departure_diagnostic.scope: This recorded marker run reached once then finished outside the tolerance. Read-only decomposition is separate from the all-trajectory existential success test; no extra control constraint was added.
